summary: A phishing site impersonating the Spectre service was reportedly surfaced through a ChatGPT response about where to swap FLR and was used to steal more than 2200000 dollars from victims. One victim reportedly lost 2100000 dollars after interacting with the malicious site.
user_mistake: trusted an unverified crypto service link provided by an AI assistant
prevention: Confirm AI provided crypto links against the projects independently verified official domain before connecting a wallet / Reject wallet transactions requesting unexpected permissions
